_doc: BINANCE HEIST VO: Liam (Turbo v2.5, hi), news delivery: stability 0.25, style 0.6. Facts: docs/factcheck.md (Binance Nov 3 report + NBC/The National). Windows re-laid by timing_heist.py.

reel.cap: Ek fake job interview… aur $6.34 BILLION ka crypto hack?!
reel.tts: एक fake job interview… और six point three four billion dollars का crypto hack?!

reel.cap: Binance ki Nov 3 report: Oct 29 ko $6.34B ke assets impact hue.
reel.tts: Binance की November three report: October twenty-nine को six point three four billion dollars के assets impact हुए.

reel.cap: June mein ek engineer ne AI coding tool dhoondhte hue tampered tool install kar liya.
reel.tts: June में एक engineer ने AI coding tool ढूँढते हुए tampered tool install कर लिया.

reel.cap: September mein doosre ko fake 'Project Director' mila — interview, fake CEO, aur ek 'assignment'.
reel.tts: September में दूसरे को fake Project Director मिला — interview, fake CEO, और एक assignment.

reel.cap: Us assignment mein malicious code tha. Oct 20 ko attackers ne internal AI tool ko springboard banaya.
reel.tts: उस assignment में malicious code था. October twenty को attackers ने internal AI tool को springboard बनाया.

reel.cap: Ruko — AI ne khud chori nahi ki; attackers ne uska access misuse kiya.
reel.tts: रुको — AI ने ख़ुद चोरी नहीं की; attackers ने उसका access misuse किया.

reel.cap: Oct 29: hot wallet se 18,270 bitcoin attacker ke paas.
reel.tts: October twenty-nine: hot wallet से eighteen thousand two hundred seventy bitcoin attacker के पास.

reel.cap: Lagbhag $2.85B freeze ya intercept hue — aur nuksaan Binance khud uthayega.
reel.tts: लगभग two point eight five billion dollars freeze या intercept हुए — और नुक़सान Binance ख़ुद उठाएगा.

reel.cap: FBI ne North Korea-linked group ko blame kiya; North Korea inkaar karta hai.
reel.tts: FBI ने North Korea-linked group को blame किया; North Korea इनकार करता है.

reel.cap: Lesson: interview assignment ho ya GitHub repo — work laptop par unknown code mat chalao. Sandbox mein test karo.
reel.tts: Lesson: interview assignment हो या GitHub repo — work laptop पर unknown code मत चलाओ. Sandbox में test करो.

reel.cap: Comment karo SAFE — poori checklist DM karunga!
reel.tts: Comment करो SAFE — पूरी checklist DM करूँगा!
